units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 8:15">Targ. Y. Deut. VIII, 15</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 31b:9">Bekh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן דעָקֵיץ לִיעַקְצֵיה וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>מאן דעקץ תְּעַקְצֵיה</he>; Ar. <he>מאן דעֲקַס עֲקַסְתֵּיה</he>) let a scorpion sting him who stings (stung), i.e. he who ignored me deserves to be excommunicated.
